last.verdict: Cloud doubled, but a big profit miss and cash drain sent shares tumbling.

reasons.label: Profit missed badly
reasons.text: EPS $2.12 vs $3.02 expected, hurt by an $8.7 billion paper loss on investments.

reasons.label: Cash burn from spending
reasons.text: Capex hit $51.4 billion, leaving free cash flow at negative $9.1 billion.

reasons.label: More spending coming
reasons.text: 2026 capex held at $195-205 billion; 2027 expected to rise significantly, raising payoff doubts.

story: Alphabet's cloud growth has accelerated from 63% in Q1 to 103% now, but AI spending keeps climbing. Shares fell after the February and July reports on capex plans, rose after April's cloud acceleration, and now fell 12.6%.
